BC
A little game for the burrow.

Burrow Circuit is an independent, open-source community game. It reads public Squeekchain data and never asks for a wallet or transaction.

HOW IT WORKS ↗SOURCE CODE ↗

Built for fun by the community. Not an official Squeekchain product. Scores are stored on your device and are not sent to a server.
